newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares may move higher as funds return.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares may move higher as funds return.

text.p: Singapore shares may move a little higher on Tuesday in anticipation of better fund buying following public holidays in Britain and the United States, dealers said.
Both major markets were closed on Monday, leaving institutional activity minimal.
On Monday, the Straits Times Industrials Index (STII) marked time, ending 0.96 points higher at 2,056.32 with a modest 131.4 million shares traded.
But dealers said the tone of the market had been mildly supportive thanks to Wall Street's recent upward momentum.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 87.78 points to close at 7,345.91 last Friday, a record high.
